name: VSCO2-CE 中提琴声部 CC0
sampled_range: C3-A6 playable; recorded roots sustain D3-D6 (MIDI 50-86), spiccato C3-D6 (MIDI 48-86)
upper_extension_note: MIDI 85-93 uses the recorded D6 root at MIDI 86; A6 is a mapped extension, not a separately sampled root

articulation_source_semantics.sustain: VSCO2 ViolaEns susvib: real ensemble sustained vibrato, one retained v2 recording per root, embedded loops
articulation_source_semantics.spiccato: VSCO2 Violas spic: real short spiccato, one retained v2 recording tier and two true round robins per root

velocity_behavior: velocity controls amplitude only; it never selects a fictitious second recording tier
upstream: VSCO 2 Community Edition subset distributed in Virtual Playing Orchestra
upstream_version: Virtual Playing Orchestra Standard 3.3 / Wave Files 3.2 local distribution
license_scope: every runtime WAV is confined to libs/VSCO2-CE/Strings/Viola Section
